goal: Best dermatologists in Bangalore: a website that lists them, from what the internet says, each with where it came from.
why: founder 2026-09-29 ~14:55: 'Can you start from scratch? Best dermatists in Bangalore as an example of a department.' A fresh organisation, founded from the app's own sheet; the department's job is the founder's words; the person gives no facts. The product must get to the internet itself (the ask that says what it needs, the stamp, the engine its Adaptation shapes, the search, the filed list with pages) and build the site from that on the person's word. Runs on Beta 2.306.15 (run 2's fixes: sutra 86100e73).

one department under Root after one Stamp, with a name of its own

verify.check: a website department under the Root
